_note_nudge: FR-SEAS-001, Q-1: fresh weather moves the season blend by at most weather_cap (snow in April adds winter, heat in May adds summer); the switch is settings wave.season.weather_nudge. Temporary values.
_note_aff: Track seasonality from four sources (docs/14 §10.2): a tag decides; otherwise sound · words · history weighted. Sound counts only with deep analysis (weight × conf), so an unanalysed track is never given a season by library means.
_note_sound: Targets on the feature vector (§4.1); a criterion met scores 1, missed — falls to 0 over «tol». Temporary values until calibration (OWN-08).
